A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. All 32 pages, including equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–M, support reliable comparison through text extraction and rendered-page inspection.

before.justification: v2 reports original model-training results, scaling-law fits, downstream accuracy, inference throughput and architectural ablations in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including the large-model comparisons and supplementary dense-model and MoE experiments.

M1.justification: The conditional scaling law, constrained architecture optimization and local GQA search in Sections 3.3–3.4 and Algorithm 1 are unchanged. The corrected parameter-count identity does not change the proposed procedure.

E1.justification: Dolma-v1.7 training, the nine downstream benchmarks, WikiText evaluation and the dense-model and MoE inference scenarios are retained without changes in coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout, including the LLaMA comparisons and the open-weight models in Tables 7–8. Qwen3-0.6B's addition to the outlier-example sentence does not introduce a new evaluated comparator; it already appears in Figure 2 and Appendix F.

E3.justification: Table 1 revises the stated LLaMA-3.2-3B MLP-to-attention ratio from 4.80 to 3. This is a limited correction to a reported model setting: Appendix H already gives 3, other configuration fields are unchanged, and Table 2 still gives 4.80. It does not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The outlier, calibration, fitting-data, architectural and hardware/framework ablations are unchanged, including their appendix evidence. Revising the illustrative architecture ratios adds no new analysis.

E5.justification: Repeated-run and uncertainty reporting is identical, including Section 4's mean inference throughput over five runs and Appendix M's existing error bars.

E6.justification: Reported losses, accuracies, throughput, fitting metrics and plotted findings are unchanged, including Tables 1–2 and 6–10. The substantive numerical edits concern architectural settings; changes from 3.6 to 3.60 and 7.167 to 7.17 are equivalent formatting or rounding.

T1.justification: Section 3.3 corrects N_attn = N_non-embed × r/(r+1) to N_attn = N_non-embed/(r+1), consistent with r being the MLP-to-attention parameter ratio. The scaling-law formulations and Appendix K's FLOPs derivation otherwise remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims, including architecture-aware conditional scaling laws and gains of up to 2.1% in accuracy and 42% in inference throughput.

C2.justification: The interpretations of architectural tradeoffs, outlier exclusion, calibration and fitting-scale dependence are unchanged. Section 7 retains the same limitations concerning larger-model validation, MoE scaling laws and post-training.

D1.justification: Architectural documentation is revised in Table 1 and Section 5. The latter changes the stated LLaMA-3.2-3B ratio from 1.5 to 3.0 and Qwen3-8B from 4.67 to 3.6. Implementation details, Appendix E's training hyperparameters and resource-access information are otherwise unchanged.

R1.justification: The references, Section 6 and Appendix B are unchanged. Adding Qwen3-0.6B to an illustrative list neither introduces a cited work nor changes research positioning.

P1.justification: v3 adds author email addresses, updates the version/date stamp, lightly revises the outlier-example sentence and adjusts numerical precision. Section organization and nearly all prose remain identical.

P2.justification: The added author-contact line shifts the abstract and Figure 1 within the first page, with other small local spacing changes. Figure and table membership, structures, captions, axes and legends are unchanged.

improvement.justification: Correcting the attention-parameter identity in Section 3.3 and aligning Table 1's LLaMA-3.2-3B ratio with Appendix H improve mathematical accuracy and technical consistency. These are localized improvements to unchanged research evidence; Table 2 still retains the conflicting 4.80 ratio, leaving the consistency correction incomplete.
